locations.name: Bandar Abbas
locations.description: Primary Iranian port city on the Strait of Hormuz. Key commercial and military hub.
infrastructure: Bandar Abbas Naval Base (headquarters of Iranian Navy's Southern Fleet)
Bandar Abbas International Airport / 9th Tactical Air Base (military aviation elements)
locations.notes: Critical for oil exports and naval operations. Frequently mentioned in strategic reports on Hormuz chokepoint.

locations.name: Bushehr
locations.description: Port city on the Persian Gulf coast, north of the Strait.
infrastructure: Bushehr Port (commercial and some military use)
Bushehr Air Base (Iranian Air Force base)
Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant (adjacent strategic site)
locations.notes: Important for regional power generation and naval/air support. Reports often highlight dual-use infrastructure.

locations.name: Bandar Kangan
locations.description: Port in Bushehr Province, near major gas fields.
infrastructure: Associated facilities for South Pars Gas Field
locations.notes: Primarily commercial/industrial; less military focus than Bandar Abbas but part of broader Persian Gulf port network.

locations.name: Strait of Hormuz Chokepoint
locations.description: Narrowest section of the Strait of Hormuz (~21 nautical miles wide).
infrastructure: Nearby: Qeshm Island (Iranian military presence reported in some analyses)
Hormuz and Larak islands (occasional military activity noted)
locations.notes: Global oil transit chokepoint. Coordinates represent approximate center of narrowest passage between Iran and Oman. Key feature for any basemap of the region.

metadata.source: Compiled from open geospatial knowledge and strategic location reports (2026)
metadata.purpose: Data preparation for contextily + OSM basemap visualization
